title: Washout-free synchronization, parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification of echo state networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.20112v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Echo state networks (ESNs) forecast chaotic systems for several Lyapunov times. Like all recurrent networks, ESNs require a washout before forecasting, i.e., a phase in which the full state drives the network until the reservoir state synchronizes with the system. At deployment, however, sensors measure only part of the state, with noise and at a lower sampling rate than the training data. We propose a washout-free deployment of ESNs via ensemble data assimilation. In closed loop, the ESN is a Markovian dynamical system; hence, a sequential filter can correct its reservoir state whenever data are available. The filter synchronizes an ensemble of reservoir states, drawn from the training data, with the system, and quantifies the forecast uncertainty. translated_title: 回声状态网络的无清洗同步、参数估计与不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 回声状态网络（ESN）能够在多个李雅普诺夫时间内预测混沌系统。与所有循环网络一样，ESN在预测之前需要一个“清洗”阶段，即一个完整状态驱动网络直至储备池状态与系统同步的阶段。然而在部署时，传感器仅能测量状态的一部分，且带有噪声，采样率也低于训练数据。我们提出通过集合数据同化实现ESN的无清洗部署。在闭环模式下，ESN是一个马尔可夫动力系统；因此，只要数据可用，序贯滤波器就可以校正其储备池状态。该滤波器将从训练数据中提取的储备池状态集合与系统同步，并量化预测的不确定性。我们将该方法扩展到参数化ESN以推断物理参数，并扩展到带局部化技术的并行ESN以预测高维系统。我们在Lorenz-63和…系统上测试了该方法。
tldr: 该论文提出基于集合数据同化的回声状态网络无清洗部署方法，在部分观测、含噪声且低采样率的条件下实现储备池状态与系统的同步，并可推断物理参数、量化预测不确定性以及预测高维混沌系统。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a washout-free deployment of echo state networks via ensemble data assimilation, enabling synchronization of reservoir states under partial, noisy, and low-sampling-rate observations, along with physical parameter inference, forecast uncertainty quantification, and high-dimensional system forecasting.
